usedFor: Amazon Seller Central orders reach HubSpot, where “Create or Update Contact” keeps one contact per buyer email.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The note records each order on a contact, so sales sees purchases without opening Amazon.

watchOut: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central is polling, so orders reach HubSpot after a scheduled check, not instantly.
